concerns.text: The plan references only the `aligned_dataset.schema.yaml` contract (for the aligned matrix) but does not reference the other defined contracts (`model_output.schema.yaml`, `feature_matrix.schema.yaml`, `dataset.schema.yaml`, `model_results.schema.yaml`). Each contract should be exercised by at least one pipeline step to ensure schema validation throughout the workflow.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) designates `data/processed/model_metrics.json` as the SSoT, yet the plan does not explicitly state that this file is validated against the `model_output.schema.yaml` contract. The SSoT should be tied to its schema to guarantee consistency.
